real.text: An octopus is a soft-bodied, eight-limbed mollusc of the order Octopoda.

fake.text: Octopuses are intelligent sea creatures with eight arms and ink.

rounds.tell: The AI adds “intelligent” and “ink,” while the human sentence is a neutral taxonomic description (“soft-bodied… mollusc… order Octopoda”).

real.text: The Eiffel Tower is a lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.

fake.text: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower in Paris, France.

rounds.tell: The AI omits “on the Champ de Mars” and replaces it with the vague location “in Paris, France,” making its wording less specific than the human sentence.

real.text: A honey bee is a eusocial flying insect from the genus Apis of the largest bee family, Apidae.

fake.text: Honey bees pollinate flowers, turning nectar into honey while working together in hives.

rounds.tell: The AI sentence adds specific behaviors (“pollinate flowers,” “turning nectar into honey,” “working together in hives”) absent from the Wikipedia-style taxonomic wording.

real.text: A volcano is a vent or fissure in the crust of a planetary-mass object that allows hot lava, volcanic ash, and gases to escape from a magma chamber below the surface.

fake.text: A volcano is a rupture in the Earth's crust through which molten rock, ash, and gases erupt from beneath the surface.

rounds.tell: It says “a rupture in the Earth's crust,” which is narrower and less precise than “a vent or fissure in the crust of a planetary-mass object,” from Wikipedia.

real.text: Coffee is a beverage brewed from roasted, ground coffee beans.

fake.text: Coffee warms the soul, sparking bright thoughts at dawn.

rounds.tell: It’s poetic and vague (“warms the soul,” “sparking bright thoughts at dawn”) with emotional imagery, not the factual, technical process description (“brewed from roasted, ground coffee beans”).

real.text: A rainbow is an optical phenomenon caused by refraction, internal reflection and dispersion of light in water droplets resulting in a continuous spectrum of light appearing in the sky.

fake.text: Rainbow is a meteorological phenomenon that appears as a spectrum of light in the sky when sunlight is refracted, dispersed, and internally reflected by water droplets.

rounds.tell: “Meteorological phenomenon” is not in the human sentence, and the wording “spectrum of light in the sky” is phrased more generally rather than mirroring the detailed “caused by … in water droplets.”

real.text: The Moon is the only natural satellite of Earth.

fake.text: Moonlight spills on silent streets like silver.

rounds.tell: AI uses poetic, personifying imagery (“Moonlight spills,” “silent streets,” “like silver”) rather than a factual, unembellished astronomical statement.

real.text: A bicycle, also called a pedal cycle, bike, push-bike or cycle, is a human-powered or motor-assisted, pedal-driven, single-track vehicle, with two wheels attached to a frame, one behind the other.

fake.text: A bicycle is a human-powered vehicle with two wheels in a frame, propelled by pedaling that turns the chain and drives the rear wheel.

rounds.tell: The AI adds technical phrasing (“pedaling that turns the chain and drives the rear wheel”), while the human definition uses broader, non-mechanistic wording without chain/rear-wheel specifics.
